name: PostgreSQL to Facebook Ads Conversions
steps:
1.  Select the [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html) and create a data model from which you want the data for your Facebook Ads. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html#_datachannel_managed_warehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
2.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Facebook Ads account using OAuth using the process described [in the documentation here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/set-up/authentication.html#_connecting_using_oauth).
3.  Click on add Data Sync button to start adding data syncs to your account.

![facebook ads reverse etl sync configuration in data channel](/images/cms/reverse-etl-destinations/facebookads-reverseetl-1--28d21f.png)

*Adding a Data Sync to Facebook Ads in DataChannel*

4.Map the fields from your data model to fields in Facebook Ads.
